title: Identify the Linux Package Manager
objective: Determine if the host uses apt (Debian/Ubuntu), yum/dnf (RedHat/CentOS), or another package manager.
rationale: The method for checking package installation differs significantly based on the underlying Linux distribution.
inputs_required: Access to the Linux shell environment
expected_output: A variable identifying the correct package manager command (e.g., 'apt', 'yum', 'dnf').
success_criteria: The script successfully determines the package manager type.
The package manager command is stored for use in subsequent tasks.
